description: This file defines classes and methods for managing runtime testing contexts and execution within the oeqa testing framework, including target setup, command registration, and controller module loading.

classes.name: OERuntimeTestContext
classes.description: Represents the runtime test context, managing target commands and environment setup.

classes.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor
classes.description: Handles execution of runtime tests, including command registration, target setup, and controller module loading.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContext.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the runtime test context with target, packages, and dump directory.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContext._set_target_cmds
methods.description: Sets up target commands, adding '-ef' if 'procps' is in image packages.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor.getTarget
methods.description: Creates and returns a target object based on target type and IP addresses.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor.getControllerModule
methods.description: Finds and returns a controller module for a given target.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor._getControllerModulenames
methods.description: Returns list of controller module names found in oeqa/controllers directories.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor._loadControllerFromName
methods.description: Loads a controller class from module names for a given target.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor._loadControllerFromModule
methods.description: Imports a module and retrieves the controller class for a target.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor.readPackagesManifest
methods.description: Reads a manifest file and returns a set of package names.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor.getHostDumper
methods.description: Creates a HostDumper instance with specified commands and directory.

methods.name: OERuntimeTestContextExecutor._process_args
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments to set up test context parameters.
